items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (submitAfterSaleModal, alreadyRefundedQty, availableQty), but the file has many large template-string HTML blocks with inline styles and almost no comments on the refund and discount logic. Raw `${order.status}` is shown untranslated in the detail modal.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: A single 1933-line index.html (cap: file > 500 lines). Rendering mixes markup, inline styles and logic in long functions such as openOrderDetailModal and openAfterSaleModal. Available-quantity calculation is redone in the UI modal (alreadyRefundedQty reduce).

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Hidden tests test_cart_rejects_illegal_quantity and test_coupon_threshold_and_invalidation failed, so boundary validation of quantities and coupon invalidation is broken. UI uses `parseInt(qtyInput.value) || 0`, which silently turns bad input into 0. The seed-data test also failed.

items.name: Clerk workbench usability: amount breakdown, status hints, dangerous-action confirmation
items.name_zh: 店员工作台可用性：金额明细、状态提示与危险操作确认
items.evidence: Breakdown shows subtotal, discounts and payable/实付, and refunds appear in order details. Reset and import ask for confirm(). submitAfterSaleModal calls requestAfterSale with no confirmation step. The detail modal shows the raw status code (e.g. 'shipped') instead of a label.

items.name: Business logic lives in one place (UI and test API share it; integer-cent money)
items.name_zh: 业务逻辑集中且被界面与测试接口共用（金额按分计算）
items.evidence: The UI calls the same requestAfterSale and importData functions as the API. Money appears to be float math with toFixed (`(item.unitPrice * item.qty).toFixed(2)`), and the failed coupon-invalidation test points to a stale-discount bug in the shared pricing code.
